items.summary: Update the backend canister in `backend/main.mo` so it compiles and exposes a stable, upgrade-safe wishes store with the public methods `submitWish(text : Text) : async ()` and `getAllWishes() : async [Text]` returning all wishes in submission order.

Replace the `/wishes` page UI in `frontend/src/pages/WishesPage.tsx` with a minimal admin view that calls `getAllWishes()` and displays wishes in a clean table or list, with a visible "Refresh" button that reloads the list on demand.
Ensure the `/wishes` admin page remains hidden from the main gift page UI (no navigation link or menu item added) and remains accessible only by directly visiting `/wishes` in the browser.
Regenerate backend Candid/declarations after updating `backend/main.mo` so the frontend actor typing/bindings remain consistent with the updated canister interface.
